skills.name: Free AEO Audit
skills.description: Instant Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) audit for any website. Returns a 0-100 score, grade A-F, and prioritized recommendations for AI visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview. Free, no signup required. Tuned for Norwegian B2B SaaS but works for any URL.

endpoints.description: GET ?url=<website>&format=json returns JSON {totalScore, maxScore, grade, schema{...recommendations[]}, meta, content, technical, aiSignals, agentVisibility}. Add &lang=en (without format=json) for an English HTML report. sjekk.synligdigital.no is the Norwegian human-facing form and returns HTML, not JSON.
MCP tool analyze_aeo({url}) returns the same audit

skills.name: AI Citation Implementation (Sitert-pakken)
skills.description: Three steps for a Norwegian brand that AI assistants do not cite: (1) baseline measurement — five buying-intent questions from your market, nine byte-identical runs, and the names of who gets cited instead; (2) the changes written out for up to ten pages — JSON-LD, quotable Q&A, llms.txt and AI-crawler rules, ready to paste or delivered as a pull request; (3) a re-measurement 30 days after you publish, before/after in one document with raw data. Written outcome criterion: at least one citation of your domain in the after-runs — if it is not met, we run another round at no extra invoice. Pricing (two packages, ex. VAT): Sitert-pakken {{PRIS:sitert}} NOK one-time (invoice, 14-day terms, no meetings) and Synlig Lite 990 NOK one-time (FAQPage JSON-LD for one page, 1 business day). No ranking promise — citation in a stated, repeatable method. Method and limits: https://synligdigital.no/metode
